svg.data-weight-note: 6.4 to 7.2 lb for the line (data sheet); no weight is given for this model
svg.data-power-input: 100 to 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz, 1 A at each of two C14 inlets (inlet legend and data sheet)
svg.data-power-usage: typical 6.2 W (0.13 A) at 120 VAC and 7 W (0.10 A) at 240 VAC; maximum 28 W at both (data sheet)
svg.data-psu-redundancy: two AC entries, redundant; both expected connected by default (data sheet; installer guide p.13). The power figures are the line's; none is given per supply
svg.data-cpu: Dual-core ARM Cortex-A9 MPCore with CoreSight
svg.data-serial-pinout: automatic Cyclades and Cisco pin-out conversion (data sheet)
svg.data-optics-sfp: 1 Gb SFP fibre modules (data sheet benefits, "Integrated support for 1Gb SFP fiber modules")
svg.data-sensor-ports: environmental sensor port (RJ45, 1-wire) and four digital-in ports on the one DIGITAL IN jack (data sheet)
svg.data-certification: Emissions and immunity: FCC Class A, CE Class A, ICES-003, VCCI, RCM, KCC, BSMI, UKCA. Safety: UL, cUL, EN/IEC 62368-1, BSMI, BIS, NOM, UKCA. The cellular approvals are for cellular models (data sheet).
